units.source_text: 所以，他有意隐瞒自己的行踪，临时决定写信告诉她，自己要一个人出去旅行。

en.t: So he deliberately concealed his movements and, on the spur of the moment, decided to write and tell her that he was going off on a trip alone.

units.source_text: 对同事们那么有效果的休假秘密，不该只在那个人身上无效吧。

en.t: The secret of taking leave, which had worked so well on his colleagues, surely should not fail only with that one person.

units.source_text: 但是，要是写上名字贴上邮票，可到关键时刻，实在觉得太傻，

en.t: But if he wrote her name on it and put on a stamp, when the crucial moment came it really seemed too foolish,

units.source_text: 于是，信写好后，他原封不动地把信扔在桌子上。

en.t: so after he finished writing the letter, he left it just as it was and tossed it onto the desk.
